translations.web: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”
translations.bsb: Disregard them! They are blind guides. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit.”
translations.kjv: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
translations.asv: Let them alone: they are blind guides. And if the blind guide the blind, both shall fall into a pit.
